title: OKR initiative alignment: triage bridge & commitment ledger
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Multiple cross-functional initiatives aiming to support company-level OKRs are tracked across separate team-led backlogs. We lack a lightweight, operational mechanism to triage initiative readiness, capture cross-team commitments, and expose an auditable ledger for exec reviews.

Goal: Build a small-scope 'Triage Bridge' and 'Commitment Ledger' process + template that product managers and initiative owners use to: 1) surface initiative readiness, 2) register cross-team commitments with owners and delivery windows, and 3) produce a single living artifact for exec syncs and roadmap gating.

Scope: Process, templates, and a minimal Console dashboard wireframe (read-only) for exec view. Not in scope: automated enforcement or billing integrations. This ticket is PM-led and requires 2 engineering touchpoints and 1 design spec for the ledger UI.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Triage Bridge runbook documented and published to Confluence with step-by-step triage checklist
A2: Commitment Ledger template created (Google Sheet + JSON export format) capturing initiative, OKR mapping, owners, committed teams, delivery window, risk level, and escalation contact
A3: Two pilot initiatives (one infra, one API) registered with the ledger and validated by stakeholders
A4: Design wireframe for read-only Console 'Commitment Ledger' dashboard reviewed and approved by Design
A5: Exec-ready one-page summary generation (PDF) from ledger export verified by GTM and Eng leadership

2025-02-26 - Opted for JSON export schema compatible with Console ingestion in a later phase (fields: key, okr, initiative, owner, teams, window_start, window_end, risk, escalations, notes)

risks: R1: If teams do not keep ledger entries up to date, exec reviews will rely on stale data — mitigation: weekly automated reminder (manual for phase 1) and PM ownership enforcement
R2: Dependency on ENG-4422 (release gating infra) may delay ability to surface live gating signals — mitigation: proceed with static exports and wireframes for now
R3: Access control via Google Sheets may expose sensitive notes — mitigation: include guidance in runbook to avoid PII and put sensitive details in redacted attachments
